subcategory_text: Senior executives understand their roles and responsibilities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AT-3(1) (Senior Executive Information Security and Privacy Training)
implementation_examples: Ensure senior executives understand their privacy roles and responsibilities through onboarding briefings, periodic privacy-risk briefings, and tabletop exercises
Surface privacy-risk trends to executives in their preferred reporting format
Use board-level discussion of privacy incidents to reinforce accountability
assessment_objectives: Determine whether senior executives understand their privacy roles and responsibilities
Determine whether executives receive periodic privacy-risk briefings
Determine whether accountability is exercised through governance routines (committees, audits)
Determine whether executives can articulate the privacy-risk posture
